svg.title: Ananya breaks the paper reserve seal and records why she is doing it.
svg.desc: The clinic reserve drawer opens as Ananya tears its seal and hands a measured supply pack to Babul-da. Riju starts a paper reason log, recording urgency, witness, quantity and time.
svg.text: Page 45, panel 4 · Low decisive view across the paper reserve

text.tspan: Ananya overrides the lock openly, uses the paper
reserve and begins a contemporaneous audit record.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
